data.name: Spellcasting Master
data.description: You can focus your mind three times per day as a swift action. Once you're focused in this way, any spells you cast for the remainder of that round do not provoke attacks of opportunity. Spells with a duration of concentration that you cast in this round persist for %1 rounds after you cease concentrating.|PaSSpellcastingMasterRounds
